instruction: With both arms, lift the two far corners of the towel and fold them onto the two near corners (half fold), then let go.

outcome.real_measurement: Left fold: horizontal distance between the far-left and near-left corners < 8 cm at every judged step (same threshold as towel_fold_diagonal v1/v3). Real world: top camera, marked corners, table-plane homography.
Right fold: far-right to near-right corner distance < 8 cm at every judged step. Real world: as above.
Footprint (convex hull of the top-down projection / area at reset) < 0.70 at every judged step (towel v1/v3 threshold; an ideal half fold gives 0.5). Real world: towel segmentation area.
<= 2 % of the towel above 5 cm at every judged step (towel v1/v3). Real world: side / depth camera.

Lifted (process term, new): at some step of the episode the far-left corner region (3 x 3 vertices at the corner) was >= 5 cm above the table, so a fold made by dragging the corner along the table does not pass. Real world: side camera / depth, corner marker height.
Lifted: the far-right corner region was >= 5 cm above the table at some step. Real world: as above.

counterexamples.name: expert
counterexamples.description: positive control: both arms lift the far corners, carry them over the near corners, lower, release, retreat

counterexamples.name: drop_midway
counterexamples.description: both grippers open halfway through the carry

counterexamples.name: drag_on_ground
counterexamples.description: grip and drag both far corners to the near corners without lifting

source.derived_from: imsim/imsim/soft/contracts/towel_fold_diagonal_v3.json (E20 binding revision 2): same thresholds, release rule and settle constants, two corner-distance terms instead of one, quiescence over the four corners; NEW lifted terms (E20 open problem 4: a drag can fold the towel)
source.engine: newton-1.7.0 VBD cloth; robots SAPIEN 3.0.3 / PhysX (E20 route A, one-way bridge)
source.frozen: E23, 2026-11-15, written and hashed before any DualFoldTowel-v1 episode was run

notes: Signals (DualFoldTowelEnv.cloth_signals, per world): towel_dist_L/R = |FL-NL|_xy, |FR-NR|_xy; towel_footprint_ratio by the recorder (veritask scipy hull); towel_frac_above_5cm (GPU); towel_lift_L/R = highest vertex of the 3x3 patch at the far corner; robot_cloth_impulse = VBD contact force x dt over every robot collider (both arms) summed over the substeps of a control step; finger_cloth_enclosure = smallest over the two grippers of the sum of the two pads' clearances to the nearest particle between the pads (1 m when none); cloth_speed_p95; towel_<corner>_<xyz>; robot_qvel_max = largest arm joint speed of both arms. Hold A = both arms held at the joint positions reached, grippers keep their last target. No retreat aftermath (the release rule over particles is used, as in the towel v3 binding).
